Pricing questions

How does the free trial work?

Start with a 10-day free trial. We set everything up and launch your first review campaign, and you're only billed on day 10 if you decide to stay. No contract, cancel any time.

What's the difference between the plans?

Only the number of new review requests we send each month. Every plan includes every feature, one past-customer reactivation campaign and unlimited follow-ups.

Are there setup fees?

No. Setup and your 1-on-1 setup call are included.

Can I cancel any time?

Yes. No lock-in contract. Cancel any time. There's nothing to sign and no exit fee.

Can I change plans later?

Yes. Move up or down whenever your business changes. The new price applies from your next billing date.

Do you offer pricing for multiple locations or franchises?

Yes. Get in touch and we'll put together a bundle for your locations.
